caption: A person in a dark navy hoodie steps up to a hallway table, reaches into the rows of plastic water bottles, lifts one bottle and holds it low at their side, then turns away toward the lockers while a second person in grey stands beside them.

labels.action: reaches toward the rows of water bottles on the table
grasps and lifts a plastic water bottle from the table
holds the water bottle low by the body, neck down
bottle passes out of view behind the body as the person turns away from the table

scene.setting: school hallway snack table beside lockers
scene.viewpoint: high angle from the front-right, person partly turned away

issues: The two people overlap at the table and the navy person's body occludes their hands, so the grasping hand (left vs right) and where the bottle ends up cannot be confirmed.
